people.imagined: The new furnace being lit. He rolls up his sleeve to renew the signing vow on his forearm, thumbing the scratched-out line. He is watching someone who skipped the vow, and he notes it.
people.subject: The moment: beside a new furnace he holds his right forearm up and out toward the viewer, sleeve pushed to the elbow, while his eyes slide to someone off frame. Face: most important, the tattooed forearm: the inside of the forearm is covered with six short black lines of small tattooed script-like strokes in a column, the fourth one scratched through with a raw red scar, large in the frame (strokes only, no readable text). A narrow, pale, anxious face; deep-set, restless, grey eyes; thin brows pulled together; a long straight nose; thin compressed lips; a day's stubble. Hair: black, combed flat and tied in a plain topknot with a red-gold thread. Body: wiry, tense, shoulders up. Clothing: a plain grey linen robe with crossed collar, perfectly clean; a thin red-gold thread stitched round each cuff; a leather smith's apron, scorched at the hem; leather wrist guards, the right one removed. Hands and objects: the bare tattooed forearm; his left hand grips a long pair of iron tongs holding a bar of dull red metal. Background: a dim furnace hall, an arched mouth glowing orange, black shadows. Light: strong orange furnace light from the right on the forearm, grey light from the upper left. Expression: watchful, suspicious, exact. A faint hot red-orange hint of fire with a grey-gold metal gleam.

people.imagined: The auction floor in the instant before the hammer. She holds up her right hand, the forefinger bare, the other nine fingers heavy with rings, and decides the price by a glance. She wants the steward's floor.
people.subject: The moment: at the auction floor she raises her right hand beside her face, fingers spread, her gaze fixed on an object off frame. Face: most important, the rings: heavy rings of gold, jade and dark metal on every finger and thumb of the hand held up, except the right forefinger which is completely bare, large in the frame. A smooth, oval, poised face; high cheekbones; narrow, cool amber eyes under straight dark brows; a small straight nose; full lips with a faint appraising smile. Her lips are painted a soft dark red and her lashes are long. Hair: black, glossy, in a tight high coil with a single narrow red-gold thread wound at the collar. Body: slim, long-necked, upright. Clothing: a plain, well-cut grey silk robe with a crossed collar, a thin red-gold thread stitched at the collar edge; wide sleeves with grey linings; no other colour. Hands and objects: the ringed hand raised; in the other hand a small wooden hammer with a red-gold head resting on a block. Background: a blurred, crowded auction floor, tall lamps. Brass lamps glow in a long arc over rows of padded benches and the shapes of bidders are only suggested. Light: warm yellow from lamps at the upper right, soft grey light on the left. Expression: a poised, calm, appraising half-smile, the amber eyes cool and certain, an ambitious woman who decides the price with a glance; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi and a hint of earth-yellow.

people.imagined: The vault's weighing room. She is new, placed from Lạc Hà this spring, and she tilts a scale to weigh a chunk of ore while her brass weights chime at her belt. In her head is a list of what she will buy in 1230.
people.subject: The moment: in a weighing room she leans over a small scale with an ore chunk in the pan, eyes on the balance, her belt jingling. Face: most important, the brass weights: a string of small brass weights in graduated sizes hanging from her belt on a cord, clustered at the bottom of the frame, glinting. A plain, round, earnest, freckled face; short dark brows; level brown eyes; a flat nose; a closed, patient mouth. Hair: brown, a single plain braid pinned up at the back. Body: sturdy and short. She stands with her feet together and her elbows against her ribs, small and neat in the narrow room. Clothing: a plain grey linen jacket with an outer disciple's collar, no thread; a long grey apron; sleeves rolled; a leather satchel. Hands and objects: one hand adjusting a tiny weight on a brass pan scale; a lump of red-brown ore. The scale's pans are of dull brass, and the ore is brown-red with a streak of pale metal; the weights on her belt run from a grain-sized one to a thumb-sized one. Background: a dim vault room with shelves of locked iron boxes. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. The grey light shows the dust floating over the scale and lies cold on the brass. Expression: patient, practical, quietly calculating. A faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: The ash pit at noon. He grins and the front tooth flashes. His cousin lost his post through a rumour he spread, and he is still sifting for the lump he saw put back.
people.subject: The moment: in the ash pit at noon he grins at the viewer, ash dusting his shoulders, a sorting sieve in his hands. Face: most important, the tooth: his upper left front tooth is bright gold-flecked, a flash of yellow metal in his grin, plainly visible. A lean, sharp, sun-dark face; quick, shrewd brown eyes; arched brows; a pointed nose; a crooked grin. Fine grey ash lies in his eyelashes. Hair: black, cropped short and dusted grey with ash. A few short strands stand out at the crown. Body: lanky, loose-limbed. His knees are drawn up and he sits on the heap with his back slumped, jaw jutting slightly. Clothing: a plain grey linen jacket with sleeves rolled to the elbow; a leather sorter's apron; a kerchief at the neck; ash on the knees. Hands and objects: a flat sieve of wire held in both hands with chunks of dull ore and glints of red gold. The sieve is a round wooden frame with a wire mesh, and in its middle lie three chunks of dull ore and one bright red-gold fleck; his left cuff is singed brown at the edge. Background: a grey slag heap, a black pit, hazy yellow sky. Light: harsh yellow noon light from the upper left. The harsh light bleaches the ash on his hair almost white. Expression: a quick, sly, ambitious grin that flashes the gold-flecked tooth, a lad still sifting for the lump he saw put back; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: A hot day on the auction floor. He copies the lot book with his collar buttoned to the chin, sweat on the lip but nothing out of place; he knows which names the steward leaves out.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk copying a book, in a hot room, he glances up at the viewer with his lips tightened. Face: most important, the buttoned collar: a stiff grey collar buttoned up to the chin with a red-gold thread along its edge, even though beads of sweat stand on his lip and forehead. A narrow, proud, pale face with a long nose; light eyes half-lidded with disdain; thin brows; thin lips in a faint sneer. Hair: black, oiled and parted exactly, in a small tight knot. Body: slim, rigid, very upright. His back is rigid against the chair and his elbows hold close to his body, like a boy at an examination. Clothing: a grey silk robe with a crossed collar closed to the throat; a red-gold thread at the collar edge; narrow sleeves with ink-clean cuffs; a jade toggle. Hands and objects: a fine brush in his right hand; a bound blank book open before him. The brush has a black lacquered handle and a perfect point, and beside the bound book sits a small porcelain water-dropper shaped like a duck. Background: a bright shuttered office, a stack of boxes. Light: hot yellow light from the upper left. The hot light lies on the paper and the beads of sweat on his lip glisten. Expression: Tightened lips and a proud, cool lift of the chin, his eyes quick and concealing, the face smooth and dry. A faint grey-gold hint of metal.

people.imagined: The clear brook at Khê Thanh. She wades with the washing basket, a strand of green brook weed tangled in her hair, wanting to be taught the canon her sister has no wish for.
people.subject: The moment: standing ankle-deep in a clear brook with a basket on her hip, she looks over her shoulder at the viewer, curious and eager. Face: most important, the weed: a long strand of green brook weed tangled in her dark hair and trailing down onto her shoulder, bright against her black hair. A fresh, round, pink-cheeked face; bright brown eyes; thin brows; a small snub nose; a wide friendly smile. Her nose and cheeks are freckled and a little pink from the sun. Hair: black, in loose waves to the shoulder, one side tucked behind her ear. Body: sturdy and small, shoulders square. She stands with one foot in front of the other in the water, ankles pale and wet. Her calves are brown and a few drops of water bead on her shins. Clothing: a plain, clean grey-green linen blouse with the sleeves tied up, a dark blue skirt tucked up to the knees; a wet apron of coarse linen; bare feet; no ornament. Hands and objects: a flat reed basket of washed bright red-gold grains, held at her hip. The reed basket on her hip holds a bed of bright red-gold grains with a little water running through; the dripping edge of her skirt is dark blue. Background: a sparkling brook over pale pebbles, green ferns. Light: bright clear daylight from the upper left, water glitter. The sparkle of the brook throws moving ripples of light on her face. Expression: a bright, honest, eager curiosity, round cheeks lifted in a wide smile, a girl who wants to be taught the canon her sister will not learn; a faint green and blue hint of wood and water qi.

people.imagined: The cage house, a winter dusk. She rolls up her sleeves to feed, and every crescent bite-scar on both arms has a name. She sends ice to a bear that she can no longer feed.
people.subject: The moment: in a cage house she holds both bare forearms forward, palms up, sleeves pushed high, as she crouches to feed an unseen animal. Face: most important, the bite scars: dozens of pale crescent-shaped scars climb both forearms to the elbows, ranked in rows like little moons, clear and big in the frame. A weathered, strong, tanned face with a broad jaw; gentle, dark, patient eyes; thick straight brows; a short nose; a calm, soft mouth. Hair: black, in a thick braid wrapped around the head, bound with leather. Body: broad-shouldered and sturdy, crouched. She crouches on the balls of her feet with her elbows on her knees, her shoulders very wide. Clothing: a plain grey linen jacket with the sleeves pushed above the elbows; a leather apron and gauntlet on one hand; a collar of grey fur; boots. Hands and objects: a bucket of raw meat chunks on one knee; the other hand open and still. The bucket is wooden, bound with iron bands, and holds strips of dark raw meat; beyond the bars a pair of yellow eyes shines low in the dark. Background: dim iron cage bars, shapes of animals in the dark. Light: yellow lantern light from the right, cool grey from the upper left. The lantern's warm spill lights each pale crescent scar and the thin lines beside her eyes. Expression: A soft, steady look with a brave set to the jaw, eyes tender toward the animal and her mouth quiet and reserved. A faint earth-brown hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: A gentle morning in the mistress's room; a visitor arrives with something under a cloth. Her eyes go to what they carry before their face; one red-gold pin is all her decoration.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still and upright, she looks not at the viewer but at something just below the camera, eyes fixed on what they hold. Face: most important, the eyes and the pin: her gaze angled downward to the object, sharp and bright as a bird's, and a single small red-gold hairpin shining at the side of her head. A small, delicate, smooth face; thin straight brows; large, very dark, quick eyes; a small, straight nose; thin lips with the faintest curve. Her skin is smooth and almost translucent, with a fine blue vein at the temple. Hair: black, glossy, coiled in a tight high bun at the crown, fixed by one red-gold pin. Body: small, upright and slight; narrow shoulders squared. Clothing: a plain grey silk robe with a crossed collar, perfectly fitted and without any embroidery; wide plain sleeves; a grey sash; nothing else. Hands and objects: both hands clasped in front of her; at her wrist a small block of polished red gold on a cord, like a seal. Her fingers are slender and her nails are cut short and clean. Background: a bare, pale, quiet room with a single lacquer table. Light: soft cool light from the upper left, a tiny glint on the pin. Expression: a keen, composed, acquisitive stillness, the dark eyes quick as a bird's and the lips with the faintest curve; a faint warm gold-red hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: Furnace mouth, mid-refining. He lifts the cracked crucible lid like a shield and speaks as little as the hammer allows. Red-gold scales shine on his apron.
people.subject: The moment: facing the furnace mouth he holds up a large cracked round iron lid in front of his chest like a shield and looks over the top of it. Face: most important, the scalp and the lid: a bare, glazed, shiny, red-pink burn-scarred scalp without a hair, catching the furnace light, and a large cracked round iron crucible lid held in front. A broad, square, heavy face; small, deep-set, black eyes; no eyebrows to speak of; a wide flat nose; a thick, firm mouth; a heavy jaw. Faint scorch marks dot his cheekbones and the skin of his jaw is stiff and shiny. Hair: none; bald. Body: huge, a barrel chest, shoulders like furnace bars. Clothing: a thick apron of linked red-gold scales over a plain grey linen shirt with the sleeves cut off; thick forearms bare, burn-glazed; a red-gold thread stitched at the shirt's collar; a leather belt. Hands and objects: the cracked lid in his left hand, big and dull grey with a crack; a flying sword of red gold hanging point down in his right hand, gleaming. Background: a roaring orange furnace mouth, black beams. A long iron rack of tongs and ladles rises on the dark wall and sparks hang in the air. Light: strong orange from the right, grey-white from the upper left. Expression: a stolid, honest, silent patience, the small black eyes steady over the lid's edge; a hot red-orange and gold hint of fire and metal qi.

people.imagined: The auction steward at the door of the floor, calling every guest by name. His silk coat is good but the cuffs are frayed because he has lost more at the table than he earns.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the doorway of a hall he spreads his hands in welcome, smiling broadly, calling a name. Face: most important, the unravelling cuffs and the smile: wide silk sleeves with the cuff edges visibly unravelling into loose silk threads, held out in the foreground; a broad, shining smile. A plump, round, smooth face; rosy cheeks; small bright black eyes with a flicker of unease; thin, neat brows; a button nose; a double chin; a thin moustache. A sheen of oil on his nose and brow catches the light. Hair: black, slicked and thinning, in a small topknot with a jade pin. Body: plump, short, a round belly. Clothing: a good dove-grey silk coat, well cut, but its cuffs and hem are coming loose into threads (the one flaw he cannot hide, since he gambles away more than he earns); a red-gold thread at the cuffs; a jade belt-plaque; an over-large coin on a chain. Hands and objects: both hands spread wide, one with a large red-gold ring; a small book tucked in the belt. Background: the lit doorway of an auction hall with blurred crowd. Silk lanterns hang in the doorway and guests in fine dark robes wait their turn in soft focus. Light: warm yellow from the doorway, soft grey from the upper left. Expression: an ingratiating, glossy, over-bright smile with a flicker of unease in the small eyes, a steward calling every guest by name and counting what he owes; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: A northern road in snow. She has just returned from buying a white bear, and the fur collar is damp with snow. The scar through her eyebrow, from a bear's paw, whitens in the cold.
people.subject: The moment: standing in falling snow she turns her face toward the viewer and lets out a short unamused breath. Face: most important, the scar: a pale ridged scar runs straight through her left eyebrow from the forehead to the cheekbone, splitting the brow, white against her tan, big and plain. A lean, hard, travel-browned face; narrow, cold, grey-green eyes; straight dark brows; a long nose; thin lips set in a callous line; chapped cheeks. Snowflakes melt on her lashes and the tip of her nose is red. Hair: black with a few grey, tied in a long single tail with leather, snow caught in it. Body: lean, strong, tall, standing wide. Clothing: a dark grey wool travelling coat with a wide collar of thick white northern fur; a plain red-gold thread at the cuff of an inner shirt just showing; leather gloves; a heavy belt; a bundle on one shoulder. Hands and objects: a coiled chain leash in the right hand; the left gloved hand on a strap. The chain leash is dark iron, wet with snow, and its last links vanish into the flurry. Background: a snowy track, bare trees, a heavy cart dim in the flurry. Light: cold white-blue light from the upper left. Expression: a hard, callous, bored look with cold eyes, a brave woman who has just bought a white bear and feels nothing about it; a faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The vault clerk on her day off, sifting the ash of Kim Cốc Thành. She coughs into her sleeve, hides it, and holds up a handful of ash in a gloved palm to the light.
people.subject: The moment: in a grey ash field she coughs into her sleeve, eyes watering, a hand of ash held out. Face: most important, the ash in the knuckles: fine grey ash worked deep into every crease and knuckle of her bare hand held out toward the viewer, dark lines of grey on the pale skin, large in the frame. A thin, pale, tired, careful face; hollow cheeks; light grey eyes red-rimmed; thin brows; a pinched nose; thin lips; her sleeve at her mouth. A thin streak of grey dust crosses her cheek where she wiped it. Hair: grey-streaked brown, pinned in a bun with a plain wooden pin, a grey scarf over it. Body: thin, narrow, slightly stooped. Clothing: a plain grey linen robe with sleeves tied back; a grey wool shawl; a red-gold thread at the cuff; a sifting apron of coarse cloth. Hands and objects: a wire sieve in the left hand; the right hand open with ash. Her wrist bones are thin, and a pale cough-stain of grey marks the cuff of her sleeve. Background: a flat grey plain of ash and burnt stone, a few charred timbers, a pale haze. Light: dull flat grey light from the upper left. Expression: a patient, honest, wary tiredness, the red-rimmed eyes steady on the ash held to the light; a faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi in the dust.

people.imagined: The furnace door. He has been told to forget the ring he saw in 1190. He holds a new hand's wrist near the heat to teach respect, and the lashless eyes stay perfectly dry.
people.subject: The moment: at the furnace door he holds out a hand gripping a young man's wrist (just the wrist and sleeve at the frame edge), his own face lit by the glow. Face: most important, the missing lashes: his eyelids are bare pink-red rims with no lashes at all, giving his wide black eyes a bare, staring look. A broad, flushed, heavy-jawed face; thick, short black brows; a short flat nose; a thin, cruel, patient smile; sweat shining on the forehead. Hair: black, cropped close. Body: thickset and strong, short neck. His neck is short and thick and he leans slightly forward, like a bull at a gate. Clothing: a scorched grey linen shirt with the sleeves rolled; a leather apron; a thin red-gold thread stitched round each cuff; thick leather gloves tucked in the belt. Hands and objects: a heavy right hand holding another's wrist; a long iron poker in the left. The poker is black iron with a hooked end, glowing faintly orange at the tip; the wrist he grips belongs to someone unseen, whose sleeve is a plain grey cuff with a thread at the edge. Background: an orange furnace door at his left, black wall. Light: strong orange from the left across his face, grey from the upper left. The furnace light shines on his bald lashless eyelids and the sweat on his forehead. Expression: A flat, impassive stare with dry lashless eyes, no pity in the face, lit orange by the glow. A strong hot orange-red hint of fire qi.

people.imagined: The auction floor. A seller has put up a lot, and she squints at it as at a doubtful coin. At eleven she called a forgery false to the seller's face; she would do it again.
people.subject: The moment: on the auction floor a tall girl squints hard at an object just in front of the viewer, chin out. Face: most important, the squint: her right eye narrowed nearly shut, her left eye wide open, the brows pulled to a sharp line, as if weighing a doubtful coin. A narrow face with a sharp, pointed chin; clear tan skin; very dark eyes; a straight, sharp nose; a thin, straight, righteous mouth. Hair: black in a tall, tight, high ponytail with a red-gold thread. Body: tall, thin, upright, long neck. She stands with her chin out and her long neck stretched forward, shoulders back, like a heron. Clothing: a plain grey silk robe with a crossed collar, a red-gold thread stitched at the collar edge, crisp and perfectly pressed; narrow sleeves; a grey sash. Hands and objects: in her right hand a small round red-gold mirror polished bright, held up to her squinting eye; in her left a finger pointing. The mirror is the size of a palm, framed in a thin ring of red gold, and a thin dark line on its face shows a flaw as a thread; her free hand's forefinger is long and bony. Background: a blurred auction floor with tall lamps. Light: warm yellow from lamps at the upper right, grey light on the left. The lamp glow touches her squinting eye and the rim of the mirror with a spark. Expression: A hard, squinting stare with the chin thrust out, a proud, honest scorn at the mouth and a clear, fair-minded eye. A faint warm gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: Slag pit at midday, a lazy afternoon. He weighs a heavy lump in one hand and puts it back; the walk to the office is long. Red-gold dust is on his cheekbones, and he will not wash it.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a slag heap he holds a heavy dull lump in one hand, weighing it up and down, then drops it, shrugging. Face: most important, the dust: a glitter of fine red-gold dust scattered across his cheekbones and the bridge of his nose like freckles of metal, shining in the sun. A round, lazy, good-natured face; half-lidded brown eyes; short straight brows; a flat nose; a loose, slow smile. Hair: dark brown, thick and sticking up, dusted with ash. Body: heavy-set, slouched. He sits with his legs sprawled and his big hands loose, his belly rounded over his belt. Clothing: a plain grey linen shirt with rolled sleeves, dirty at the cuffs; a leather sorter's apron; a rope belt; loose trousers. Hands and objects: a heavy dull lump of grey slag in his right hand; his left hand resting on his knee. The slag lump is black and glassy with a heavy dull weight, a pocked skin and one bright orange vein; a half-empty water gourd lies at his hip. Background: a grey slag heap, a dark pit, a pale yellow sky. Light: bright yellow noon light from the upper left. The yellow light makes the dust on his cheeks twinkle like tiny gold sparks. Expression: A lazy, easy shrug of a face with heavy lids and a slack, trusting half-smile, content with the heap. A faint grey-gold hint of metal qi.

people.imagined: The studio yard, a new boy with a letter. A bruise on his shin from a different stumble each week; he stands carefully, with a patient face, three times failed by a hair.
people.subject: The moment: standing carefully in a yard he holds a sealed letter in both hands against his chest, then glances down at his shin. Face: most important, the shin and bruise: one trouser leg is rolled to the knee and the shin has a fresh purple-blue bruise the size of a palm, with a yellow older one beside it, large in the frame at the bottom. A plain, narrow, earnest face; large, anxious, brown eyes; thin pale brows; a straight nose; a closed, patient mouth. Hair: brown, cropped, a cowlick. Body: lanky, careful, shoulders drawn in. He stands with his knees locked and his thin shoulders squared, one leg a little forward to show the bruise. Clothing: a plain grey linen jacket of an outer disciple, no thread; a cloth belt; trousers one leg rolled; a well-dug brown stain on the knees; straw sandals. Hands and objects: a folded letter (no writing visible) held to the chest; a well-digger's small spade on his back. The letter is folded in thirds with a plain red wax blob; the little spade on his back has a worn wooden handle, and mud dries on its blade. Background: a studio yard with grey walls, a well. Light: soft grey light from the upper left. The even grey light shows both the fresh purple and old yellow bruises plainly. Expression: A careful, patient look with lowered eyes and a humble tilt of the head, the young face anxious yet steady. A faint earth-yellow hint of earth qi.

people.imagined: The auction floor. She cries a price she was handed, true or not, and the silk scarf round her throat shakes. Her voice carries across the whole market.
people.subject: The moment: mid-cry, standing on a block, her mouth wide open, a hand cupped at her ear. Face: most important, the scarf and the open mouth: a thick pale gold-yellow silk scarf wound several times round her throat, and a wide-open mouth with visible tongue and teeth, calling. A broad, round, expressive face with bright cheeks; large, shining, hazel eyes; high arched brows; a short nose; strong lips. Hair: black, braided into two long plaits pinned up in a crown. Body: stout, strong chested, planted. Her chest is deep and her stance is wide, ready to project. Clothing: a plain grey linen robe with a crossed collar and short sleeves; the pale gold silk scarf; a leather belt; a cloth apron. Hands and objects: one hand cupped at her ear, the other holding a small brass hand-bell down at her side. The brass bell in her left hand is no bigger than a fist and has a wooden handle bound with red cord; the block beneath her is a plain wooden box. Background: a blurred auction floor with a crowd and lamps. Light: warm yellow from lamps at the upper right, grey from the left. The lamp glow catches the open mouth and the shimmer of the pale gold scarf. Expression: gregarious, bright, willing to lie. A faint grey-gold hint of metal in the air.

people.imagined: The brook at Khê Thanh, early. She washes the finest refinings, water running over her cold-red feet, and is calm. The refiner trusts her hands more than his own.
people.subject: The moment: crouched on a stone in a clear brook she holds out both hands, dripping, the water running off her wrinkled fingertips. Face: most important, the hands: both hands wrinkled white and puckered to the second knuckle from water, held up and dripping, and bare feet red from the cold in the water below. A calm, soft, round face; clear, still, dark eyes; thin straight brows; a small nose; a gentle closed mouth. Hair: black, in a simple long braid over one shoulder. Body: sturdy, small, bent forward. She crouches on a flat stone with her knees together, her back curved forward. Clothing: a plain, clean grey-green linen blouse with the sleeves tied up; a coarse blue skirt tucked up; a wet apron; no ornament. Hands and objects: the wrinkled dripping hands; beside her on a rock a shallow reed basket of washed red-gold grains glittering wet. The grains in the basket are a bright orange-red, wet and gleaming, and each of her ten fingertips is pale and puckered like a dried plum. Background: a bright brook over pale stones, ferns, a morning mist. Light: bright clear light from the upper left, water glint. The water throws a net of moving light on the underside of her chin. Expression: A calm, quiet face with a soft, content half-smile and an honest, steady gaze lifted from the water. A faint blue-green hint of water qi.

people.imagined: 350, under the sign over the workshop door by the bay. A memorial portrait of the founder, a Xích Thổ smith who bought a mine before his lord heard of it, holding a small hammer and a lump of red gold.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a stout smith stands in his workshop door, holding a lump of red gold up to the light. Face: most important, the red-gold lump: a rough nugget of bright red-gold the size of a hen's egg, held up in a pair of tongs, the one bright colour in the picture. A broad, shrewd, ruddy face; narrow bright eyes; thick bristly black brows; a thick nose; a wide, sly, pleased mouth; a short beard. Deep laugh lines run from his nose to the corners of his mouth. Hair: black, tied back with a leather cord, a smith's cap. Body: thick, strong, squat. His forearms are thick and tanned dark, scarred by old sparks. Clothing: a leather smith's apron over a plain grey tunic; sleeves rolled; a heavy leather belt with tools; plain boots. Hands and objects: the nugget in tongs held aloft in the right hand; a small hammer in the left. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground with the faint orange of a forge. Light: soft warm light from the upper left, dark vignette. Expression: a shrewd, pleased, ambitious smile, the bright eyes narrowed on the nugget in the tongs; a faint gold hint of metal qi, softened by the fade.

people.imagined: 609, the auction floor. A memorial portrait of the second mistress who took a crier's girl off the floor, with a sutra scroll in one hand and a patient smile, a thin gold chain at the throat.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a composed woman stands holding a closed scroll with a faint smile. Face: most important, the closed scroll and the pale gold chain: a closed scroll bound with a red-gold cord held across her chest, and a thin gold chain with a small red-gold pearl at the throat. A calm, heavy-lidded, handsome face with strong cheekbones; patient dark eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a closed, mild smile. Hair: black streaked with grey, coiled in a high flat knot with two gold pins. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, still. She stands tall and wide-shouldered, the scroll held across her at a measured angle. Clothing: a long, plain, grey silk robe with a crossed collar and a faint red-gold thread at the cuffs; a grey sash; wide sleeves. Hands and objects: the scroll held in both hands. The scroll is a hand-span thick, bound with a red-gold cord tied in a double knot, and a small pale ring on her right hand matches the pearl at her throat. Background: a pale, mottled, aged-silk ground, a hint of a lamp and a hall. Light: soft light from the upper left, dark vignette. The yellowed silk deepens the shadows around her eyes and softens the cord's red-gold glow. Expression: calm, patient, greedy. A faint warm gold hint of metal qi, softened by the fade.
